$comment: The skins contract's LOCAL validation target (Appearance token model v2). Token value types are NOT defined here: every manifest/resolved document is validated against the vendored canonical set under skins/contracts/ (see canonical.delegates and skins/contracts/PIN). The canonical schemas type every length as a unitless JSON number rendered as CSS px, font-weight as unitless, and letter-spacing as a unitless ratio rendered as em; a numeric string such as "12px" is rejected. This file adds only the frozen local envelope (schema_major + the five v2 groups + optional mode overrides) and the palette/forbidden metadata. The vendored appearance-json schema validates the resolved runtime tokens.json (version 2 + the five fully resolved groups); the vendored appearance-artifact schema validates appearance.json. Templates are named <configDir>.gtk.css.j2 and expand flattened v2 placeholder paths. Layout tokens are TSX-owned and templates MUST NOT emit them as CSS. Re-vendoring must update the PIN hashes and canonical.tag together; schema_major moves independently of the repo tag.
title: dotfiles-assets appearance manifest v2

legacy.note: The v1 skin schemas are vendored at v0.7.0 for provenance only. This class emits v2 manifests and resolved tokens.json; it never mixes a v1 token map with a v2 artifact.

resolved_document.note: The runtime emits one generation tokens.json: version 2 plus the five fully resolved groups, with mode overrides already applied. Consumers validate that resolved document directly against this vendored schema, without the manifest wrapper.

canonical.note: Byte-for-byte copies of the canonical appearance and frozen v1 skin schemas are vendored under skins/contracts/ and pinned by sha256 in skins/contracts/PIN. The pinned tag is v0.7.0, the Appearance plane v2 release: the vocabulary is surface.{panel,card,cell,control,pill}, state.{hover,selected,focus,disabled}, type, ink, layout.<app> and optional mode.dark/mode.light overrides, templates are named <configDir>.gtk.css.j2 (the expander renders <configDir>.css), and the runtime document is tokens.json. Layout tokens stay in the manifest and tokens.json for skinValue() but are TSX-owned: templates MUST NOT expand them into CSS.

palette.source: icons/mappings/vocabulary.json (the declared role vocabulary of record in this repository; 50 theme-producer Material roles + on_backdrop, REQ-022)
palette.note: A surface/state/ink expression may name only one of these roles. Producer aliases (foreground, accent, accent-muted, warning) and colorN carrier indices are not roles; the validator rejects them.

notes: A skin is appearance: surface paint/geometry, interaction state, type, ink and mode overrides. Structure (which widget sits where) and variant names belong to the app.
surface/state/ink values are palette-role expressions or transparent; a literal hex colour is never a skin value.
GTK 4.24 ignores transitions, so the format forbids them rather than shipping dead declarations.
layout.<app> is a metric namespace consumed by skinValue(); templates MUST NOT expand it into CSS.
An override group replaces the base group as a whole; there is no deep merge.
